outcome: Serum levels of cell adhesion molecules (I-CAM-1, V-CAM-1, E-Selectin, P-Selectin, LRG-1)
finding: All adhesion molecules except V-CAM-1 were significantly higher in the group with placental adhesion and/or localization anomalies.
mod_finding: E-Selectin and LRG-1 adhesion molecules were significantly higher in women who had cesarean sections compared to those who had vaginal deliveries.
